title: Giants trading Dexter Lawrence to Bengals for No. 10 pick in 2026 NFL Draft

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Giants trading Dexter Lawrence to Bengals for No. 10 pick in 2026 NFL Draft
sources.description: The Giants have traded star defensive tackle Dexter Lawrence to the Bengals in a deal that includes the No. 10 overall pick in the 2026 NFL Draft.
